name: job-spot
description: Jobs a person repeats across sessions, proposed as microservices, with the parts each would reuse and the atoms it lacks.

verbs.name: find
verbs.description: Candidates from a session list and a catalog of parts. Prints one line per candidate, or the candidates with --json. Cached by sessions and catalog, model, and prompt hash, so a new --min-sessions or --min-objects costs nothing. Refuses with budget_exceeded once today's model spend reaches the daily budget.

sessions.description: Path of a session-list JSON file, as session-read prints it with --json.

catalog.description: Path of a JSON file holding { parts: [{ name, type, description }] }.

minSessions.description: Fewest known sessions a candidate must cite. 1 or more.

minObjects.description: Fewest different objects a candidate's citations must name. 1 or more.
